scenario: The ego vehicle overtakes a bus on a narrow two-lane road, then encounters pedestrians and a slow-moving three-wheeled vehicle ahead.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward, overtakes a bus by moving into the opposing lane, and then continues approaching a slower vehicle ahead.

adversarials.behavior: The bus travels straight forward in the same direction as the ego vehicle and is overtaken by the ego.
The pedestrian walks along the right side of the road in the same direction as traffic.
The pedestrian walks along the right side of the road in the same direction as traffic, carrying a pink bag.
The three-wheeled vehicle travels straight forward slowly in the same lane as the ego vehicle, ahead of the ego.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle travels on a narrow straight two-lane rural road with guardrails on both sides. A bus is initially ahead in the same lane. Two pedestrians are on the right roadside. A slow three-wheeled vehicle is further ahead in the ego's lane.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain safe passing distance while overtaking the bus in the opposing lane. The scenario terminates once the ego vehicle approaches the three-wheeled vehicle ahead.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the left side of the road, visible in the distance ahead of the ego vehicle.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the camera-host vehicle from first-person dashcam view. Adversarials: one bus, two pedestrians, one three-wheeled vehicle. 2. Chronology: Initially ego follows bus. Midpoint ego overtakes bus via left lane. Ending ego approaches slow three-wheeled vehicle with pedestrians on right roadside. 3. Evidence: Bus shifts from center to right of frame as ego passes. Pedestrians appear stationary relative to road but move through frame. Three-wheeled vehicle remains centered ahead, growing larger, indicating ego approaches it.
